title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version keeps the curated reader-facing working surface and adds RA30, a Paper 02 final-summary and table-plate visual/source audit package following the RA29 body closure.

Current reader files. The main cumulative readers and standalone English paper PDFs remain the reader-facing surface. RA25-RA30 are correction/audit tranches for the German/source branch of Paper 02, not full multilingual propagation packages.

Latest correction package. Adds N_SYM_RA30_P02_tables_20260612.zip. RA30 fixes the p.90 final summary/reference display, fixes formula (31) tag placement, moves Table I/Table II plates onto standard A4 landscape pages for source-like readability while retaining editable TeX tables, corrects selected missing outer parentheses in Table II transvectant cells, and includes source pp.90-92 plus updated output render pages as a visual dossier.

Status at a glance. This is not a certified critical edition. The files are useful working drafts, translation drafts, and source-audit correction packets; subtle formula errors, scan-reading errors, apparatus drift, and cross-language synchronization errors may remain. Verify important equations, tables, theorem statements, and unusual notation against the source witnesses before citation-critical use.

Known open items. Paper 02 body pp.23-90 is closed at the RA29/RA30 base, but the full cell-by-cell Table II lower-row audit remains open. Non-German propagation to EN/ES/JA/FR/ZH remains queued until Paper 02 plates close. Full symbol-level source audit remains open beyond Paper 01 and the current Paper 02 tranches.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
